We build
good things.

ZIP is an innovation studio that builds breakthrough initiatives for the world’s hardest problems.

We help you design and build new initiatives, funding models and innovation programmes.

Our approach ↓

The world's hardest problems fall between what governments prioritise, what charities can fund and what investors can back.

Talented people get stuck in slow-moving institutions.

Promising ideas struggle to get a chance.

And funding often comes with conditions that don’t fit the problem.

We take a problem-first approach.

Understand the problem

Bring together research, lived experience and expert insight to find opportunities for change.

Build the vehicle

Design new initiatives with unconventional partnerships, smart funding models and entrepreneurial talent.

Mobilise for the mission

Build networks and bring together the people and capital needed for the mission.
